result.instructions: Tools for MerchantPro, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which products are almost out of stock in our shop?"; "List the orders that are still awaiting shipment and their totals."; "Set the stock of SKU ABC-100 to 25.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MerchantPro data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run merchantpro_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run merchantpro_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run merchantpro_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. merchantpro_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: merchantpro_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products in the shop with stock and price summary. Filter by status, SKU, EAN, category or tag. GET /api/v2/products.

sku_match.description: Product or variant SKU containing this text.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, for example id,name,stock. Smaller payloads.

sort.description: Sort field, for example name or date_modified.desc.

tools.name: merchantpro_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get one product in full: description, stock, prices, categories, images and variants when requested with include. GET /api/v2/products/{id}.

include.description: Comma-separated extra data, for example description,variants.

tools.name: merchantpro_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders with their shipping and payment status. Filter by status, customer email, or the date the order changed. GET /api/v2/orders.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, for example id,name,stock. Smaller payloads.

sort.description: Sort field, for example name or date_modified.desc.

tools.name: merchantpro_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Get one order in full: line items, totals, addresses, payment and shipping status, invoices. GET /api/v2/orders/{id}.

tools.name: merchantpro_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers with login status and order counts. Filter by email or status. GET /api/v2/customers.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, for example id,name,stock. Smaller payloads.

sort.description: Sort field, for example name or date_modified.desc.

tools.name: merchantpro_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get one customer in full: contact, billing and shipping addresses, groups and order totals. GET /api/v2/customers/{id}.

tools.name: merchantpro_update_stock
tools.title: Set product stock
tools.description: Set the stock level of one product to an absolute value (not a change). Give exactly one of id, sku or ean. Sets stock on the live shop at once. PATCH /api/v2/inventory/stock.

id.description: Product id (give exactly one of id, sku, ean).

sku.description: Product SKU (give exactly one of id, sku, ean).

ean.description: Product EAN (give exactly one of id, sku, ean).

stock.description: Absolute stock level to set (not a change).

tools.name: merchantpro_update_prices
tools.title: Set product prices
tools.description: Set the net or gross price, and the old (strike-through) price, of one product. Give exactly one of id, sku or ean and at least one price. The live shop shows the new price at once. PATCH /api/v2/inventory/prices.

id.description: Product id (give exactly one of id, sku, ean).

sku.description: Product SKU (give exactly one of id, sku, ean).

ean.description: Product EAN (give exactly one of id, sku, ean).

price_net.description: Net price (the shop computes gross from tax).

price_gross.description: Gross price (the shop computes net from tax).

old_price_net.description: Old net price, shown struck through.

old_price_gross.description: Old gross price, shown struck through.

tools.name: merchantpro_set_order_status
tools.title: Change order status
tools.description: Move one order to in_process, shipped, delivered, returned or cancelled. The customer may get an email (send_email). Cancelling or returning an order can refund or reverse stock in the shop. PATCH /api/v2/orders/{id}/{status}.

send_email.description: true sends the customer an email, false sends none. Omit to keep the shop's default.
